clips.title: The story
paras: A faded, bloodstained letter to Yvette Farthing lies among the skeletal ruins of Agamand Mills. It recalls two lovers parted as the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, and what the Forsaken left behind when they traded life for undeath.

Thurman Agamand, eldest son of patriarch Gregor Agamand, wrote the message that never reached Yvette Farthing. When the Plague of Undeath consumed Tirisfal Glades, Thurman refused to leave his ancestral home or his kin. As the Scourge struck, he took up his quill to write to Yvette, whom he had loved before the kingdom turned to ash.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand. It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh...my poor Thurman! I begged him to leave Agamand Mills with me and my father, but his family loyalty was too strong! And I knew it! I just knew it that Brand meant him harm!! Oh, curse this Plague, and the Scourge!
But regrets are for the weak. As a Forsaken, I have new goals and love is not one of them. I would thank you for delivering this letter, for I had wondered what happened to my past love.
But that life is over. Forever.
